motion.name: ease-strike
motion.purpose: The settle of every strike (headings, cartouches, verdict plate).

motion.name: ease-flap
motion.purpose: Character flap on the clocks board.

motion.name: ease-hero
motion.purpose: Incumbent hero reveal and passport card; not used on the plate.

motion.name: strike-heading
motion.value: transform 320ms ease-strike from scale(1.02); text-shadow 320ms ease-out

motion.name: strike-cartouche
motion.value: transform 260ms ease-strike from scale(1.05), box-shadow/background 320ms ease-out, delay calc(var(--i) * 120ms)

motion.name: strike-verdict
motion.value: opacity 260ms ease-out, transform 260ms ease-strike from scale(1.04)
motion.purpose: Verdict plate landing after the proving bar.

motion.name: flap-cascade
motion.value: 380ms ease-flap forwards, rotateX(-90deg)/0.2 -> rotateX(12deg) at 60% -> 0; delay calc(var(--i) * 28ms + var(--r) * 140ms)

motion.name: assay-dwell
motion.value: 6000ms per state; hairline fill scaleX(0 -> 1) linear over the dwell; paused on hover/focus; advances only in view
motion.purpose: One object in four recoverable states.

motion.name: proving-bar
motion.value: transform 120ms linear per frame; PROVE_MS 14000, HOLD_MS 6000, CYCLE 20000; loops while in view
motion.purpose: Console proving bar ending in the struck verdict.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all strike transitions none; cartouche transform none; flap animation none; assay bar scaleX(1); progress transition none; console shows 100% and the verdict

components.name: Engraved Heading
components.description: One heading per plate, struck in on entry; add .ds-struck to play the settle.
components.html: The law asks for both.
components.css: .ds-engraved-h { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-bitter), Georgia, serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(34px, 7.5vw, 60px); line-height: 0.98; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #23272d; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-strike-h { display: inline-block; transform: scale(1.02); transform-origin: left center; text-shadow: none; transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.2, 1), text-shadow 320ms ease-out; } .ds-struck .ds-strike-h { transform: scale(1); text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.55), 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 -1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); }

components.name: Cartouche (octagon, struck numeral)
components.description: A hallmark shape debossed into the plate; the numeral sinks with it.
components.css: .ds-cartouche { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 196px; aspect-ratio: 1; color: var(--brass-ink); background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 10%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 26%, transparent); clip-path: polygon(14% 0, 86% 0, 100% 18%, 100% 82%, 86% 100%, 14% 100%, 0 82%, 0 18%); transform: scale(1.05); transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 320ms ease-out, background-color 320ms ease-out; } .ds-struck .ds-cartouche { transform: scale(1); background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 16%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 7px 9px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.42), inset 2px 3px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), inset -4px -5px 10px rgba(255,255,255,0.3), inset -1px -2px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.45); } .ds-struck-ink { font-family: var(--font-bitter), Georgia, serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(40px, 4.6vw, 66px); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 84%, black); text-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.4), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.25), 0 -1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.45), 0 -2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); }

components.css: .ds-cta-plate { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: var(--font-plex-sans), Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--steel-50); text-decoration: none; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2a2f37, #171a1f); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.12), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5), 0 10px 20px -14px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); } .ds-cta-plate:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bronze); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip (portal tab)
components.description: Field selector on the dark bench; selected state is brass.
components.css: .ds-bench { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; padding: 16px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #24282e, #1f2328); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-chip { border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 10px; font-family: var(--font-plex-sans), Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--steel-100); background: transparent; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.14); cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 160ms ease-out, background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.35); } .ds-chip[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--brass-ink); background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--brass-hi), var(--brass)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.35), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.35); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-hi); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Assay State Tab
components.description: One of four recoverable states; selected tab is pressed in and its hairline fills brass over the dwell.
components.css: .ds-state { position: relative; display: block; width: 320px; text-align: left; padding: 16px 18px 16px 20px; border-radius: 6px; border: 0; color: var(--steel-900); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms ease-out, box-shadow 200ms ease-out; } .ds-state:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent); } .ds-state[aria-selected="true"] { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 12%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 5px 7px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), inset 1px 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.22), inset -3px -4px 8px rgba(255,255,255,0.35), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5); } .ds-state:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bronze); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-state-label { display: block; font-family: var(--font-bitter), Georgia, serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(22px, 2.4vw, 30px); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-state-title { display: block; margin-top: 8px; font-family: var(--font-plex-sans), Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-state-bar { position: absolute; left: 20px; right: 18px; bottom: 8px; height: 2px; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 18%, transparent); overflow: hidden; } .ds-state-bar > i { display: block; height: 100%; width: 100%; background: var(--brass); transform-origin: left center; transform: scaleX(0); } .ds-state[aria-selected="true"] .ds-state-bar > i { animation: ds-fill var(--dwell, 6000ms) linear forwards; } @keyframes ds-fill { to { transform: scaleX(1); } }

components.name: Proving Bar and Verdict Plate
components.description: Brass bar fills over 14s, then the verdict strikes in with word and dot.
components.html: Compliant · Reg. (EU) 2023/1542
components.css: .ds-tool { width: 320px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #24282e, #1f2328); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 30px 50px -36px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); } .ds-progress { height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #121417; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.8), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05); overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress > i { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--brass-hi), var(--brass) 55%, var(--brass-lo)); transform-origin: left center; transition: transform 120ms linear; } .ds-verdict { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 16px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--verdict-dark); background: rgba(127,209,160,0.06); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(127,209,160,0.35), inset 2px 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); transform: scale(1.04); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 260ms ease-out, transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.2, 1); } .ds-verdict.ds-is-struck { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-verdict-word { font-family: var(--font-bitter), Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; }

components.css: .ds-board { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 560px; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--steel-900); color: var(--steel-50); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.06), 0 30px 50px -40px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); } .ds-board-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 14px minmax(120px, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 2fr) minmax(0, 0.8fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 20px; align-items: center; padding: 16px 20px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-board-row:first-child { border-top: 0; } .ds-lamp { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--steel-600); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-lamp-on { background: var(--amber); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(224,161,0,0.16), inset 0 -1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); } .ds-when { font-family: var(--font-bitter), Georgia, serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-is-delayed .ds-when, .ds-is-delayed .ds-status { color: var(--amber); } .ds-what { font-family: var(--font-plex-sans), Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.375; color: var(--steel-100); } .ds-ref { font-family: var(--font-plex-mono), Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--steel-300); } .ds-status { font-family: var(--font-plex-sans), Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: var(--steel-300); }

narrative.overview:
A hallmark certifies that metal meets a legal fineness without saying which mine it came from. Below the pinned hero, the whole landing is one continuous sheet of brushed light steel with a single full-bleed brass nameplate for the five marks and one oxidised-steel passage for the bench. Nothing sits on the plate; everything that matters is struck into it. Headings are engraved (light edge below, dark edge above), marks are debossed cartouches, rules are scored hairlines, and section boundaries are seams where one sheet meets the next rather than boxes or cards.

The world is dense with metal and sparse with ornament. Hierarchy is carried by size alone: Bitter 800 at four scales, IBM Plex Sans for reading, IBM Plex Mono only for hashes, ledgers and references. There are no eyebrows, no icon tiles, no glass, no card grids. Colour is almost entirely tonal steel; brass is a material (one plate, the proving bar, the selected chip, the seal) rather than an accent sprinkled on text; amber lights exactly one lamp; green appears only with the word "Compliant" and a dot.

The incumbent hero above the plate is a separate, user-pinned surface (limestone video, zinc ground, steel ink, 4px radii, a translucent passport card) and the plate system coexists with it: same fonts, same steel, same brass family, same verdict green. The site header and hero keep their own tokens from globals.css; the plate never restyles them.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous plate: sections are seams (inset highlight-then-shadow), never bordered containers.
Struck, not placed: deboss shadows, engraved text-shadows and a 1.02–1.05 → 1 settle are the single motion grammar.
Size-only hierarchy in Bitter 800; no kickers, no tracked uppercase labels in the plate world.
Brass as material: matte #a9842f body with #c9a24d highlight and #7a5a14 shadow, always in the same three-stop gradient or as a whole plate.
Green and red exist only as a verdict, always with word and shape; amber only on the delayed clock.
Reduced motion shows everything already struck and still.

rules.name: The Struck Verdict Rule
rules.body: Green appears only as "Compliant" (or red as "Non-compliant"), always as word plus dot, with the regulation cited beneath. Never as a status colour, tick, badge or background wash on its own.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Amber is one 8px lamp plus the date beside it, on the delayed clock only.

rules.name: The Brass Is Material Rule
rules.body: Brass is never a text accent on steel. It is a plate, a bar, a selected chip, a seal, the selection highlight; always modelled hi → body → lo.

rules.name: The No Blue Rule
rules.body: No blue anywhere on the site; it would make STRICKLE read as a TÜV or Midnight sub-brand (PRODUCT.md standing constraint).

rules.name: The Size-Only Rule
rules.body: In the plate world, hierarchy is size and weight in one face. No eyebrows, no uppercase tracked labels, no coloured lead-ins above a heading.

rules.name: The One Heading Per Plate Rule
rules.body: Each plate carries exactly one Headline (or the single Display); everything below it steps down through Title, Subtitle and Body.

rules.name: The Mono For Hashes Rule
rules.body: Mono is reserved for references, identifiers, hashes and ledger values; never for headings, labels or prose.

rules.name: The Pressed-In Rule
rules.body: Depth goes into the plate. The only cast shadows belong to objects that physically rest on the dark bench (tools, phone, board, certificate) and to the memo CTA.

rules.name: The Two-Edge Rule
rules.body: Every engraved element has a light edge below and a dark edge above on light metal, and the reverse on dark. One edge alone is a drop shadow and is not this world.

dos: Do build every new section as a Plate with one engraved heading and a seam; let the plate tone (steel / brass / dark) be the only container.
Do strike anything that enters: heading 320ms, cartouche 260ms + 120ms stagger, ease cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.2, 1), from an already-visible flat state.
Do write absences out ("Suppliers and quantities not disclosed") and draw sealed values as hatch, 8px tall at 0.55 alpha.
Do keep brass modelled (hi → body → lo) and give it a whole object: a plate, a bar, a chip, a seal.
Do keep reading copy at 16–17px Plex Sans, 1.625 leading, 52–58ch, in steel-700 or steel-600.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion with the struck-and-still state, never a blank one.
donts: Don't use blue anywhere, or green/red outside the "Compliant" / "Non-compliant" word-and-dot pair.
Don't add eyebrows, kickers or tracked uppercase labels above headings in the plate world; the hero's own small rail is the incumbent surface, not a licence.
Don't put cards, icon tiles, glass panels, locks, shields, globes, node graphs or floating dashboards on the plate.
Don't cast drop shadows from things on light steel; only objects on the dark bench (and the memo CTA) may pool a shadow beneath them.
Don't light more than the one delayed clock with amber, or add motion outside the four grammars (strike, flap cascade, assay dwell, proving bar).
Don't set headings in any weight but Bitter 800, or use mono outside references, hashes and ledger values.
